dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are the two of them okay?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Regarding their academic achievements, they are very happy now. They've collected empirical data, and their research turned out to be fruitful.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: But in terms of their everyday lives, they weren't even eating anymore, and their sleep patterns were terribly skewed...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: In their own words... This is the price of doing research.
